jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
Senior FP&A Analyst (Pune)

About The Role

The Senior FP&A Analyst is a key partner to Finance leadership and the wider business, driving data-driven decision making through planning, forecasting, and analysis. This role owns core FP&A processes, including budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and variance analysis, and builds the financial models and insights that shape strategic and operational decisions across Showpad.

What You’ll Do

- Develop and monitor key financial and business performance metrics (ie. ARR, bookings, EBITDA margin, and operating expenses).

- Perform monthly and quarterly variance analysis (actuals vs. budget and forecast), explaining key drivers and trends to Finance leadership and business partners.

- Build and maintain financial models for revenue, headcount, and operating expenses to support budgeting, scenario planning, and forecasting.

- Manage the planning, forecasting and reporting processes across Showpad, both long-term and short-term, including but not limited to Quarterly Forecasts and the Annual Operating Plan.

- Ensure the accuracy and completeness of company financial data, and contribute to identifying ways to remediate inconsistencies and streamline processes.

- Identify actionable insights, suggest recommendations and influence the direction of the business by effectively communicating findings to cross-functional groups.

- Build relationships with other departments and work together to establish best practices, proactively identify opportunities and streamline current processes & tools.

What You Bring

- A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; a professional qualification (CFA, CPA, MBA) is a plus.

- A mastery of Excel and g-sheets; must possess the ability to produce dynamic models and perform sensitivity analyses.

- 3-5 years of experience in Corporate FP&A or a closely related finance function, ideally at a SaaS or technology company.

- Experience with reporting, budget process, and complex financial modeling.

- Organized and detail-oriented; ability to work in situations with changing priorities and multiple simultaneous assignments.

- Solid grounding in accounting principles (Ind AS, IFRS, or US GAAP).

- Familiarity with SaaS business model and revenue drivers.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

Location: We're hiring for this role in Boston, with two days per week in the office (Tuesdays and Thursdays).

We are looking for an HR Business Partner to join our People Team at Showpad. In this role, you will serve as a strategic partner to executives and business leaders while also rolling up your sleeves to execute and continuously improve people programs. You will partner closely with senior leaders across the business — serving as a trusted advisor on all people matters that intersect with business performance.

You sit comfortably at the intersection of strategy and operations — able to hold your own in a leadership conversation about organizational design in the morning, and drive a performance cycle or navigate a complex employee relations matter in the afternoon. You lead with a lens of equity and inclusion, build trust quickly, and influence without authority. You bring independent judgment, a bias for action, and a genuine passion for creating environments where people can do their best work.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic HR Partnership

- Act as a trusted advisor to executives, senior leaders, and managers on the full range of HR matters, including organizational design, workforce planning, and talent strategy.

- Translate business goals into people strategies and proactively identify people risks and opportunities before they escalate.

- Build deep, credible relationships at all levels of the organization by delivering on commitments and maintaining confidentiality.

Employee Relations & HR Expertise

- Independently manage complex employee relations issues — including investigations, disciplinary actions, performance management, and conflict resolution — with sound judgment and a fair, compliance-grounded approach.

- Provide coaching and guidance to executives, senior leaders, and managers on navigating difficult conversations, including performance improvement, terminations, and team dynamics.

- Maintain in-depth knowledge of applicable employment laws and regulations (US and EMEA) and proactively apply this knowledge to mitigate legal risk.

- Stay current on HR trends, emerging practices, and legal developments; bring relevant insights back to the team.

Program Execution & Operational Excellence

- Own and execute core People programs end-to-end — including merit cycles, performance reviews, engagement surveys, and exit processes — with precision and a focus on continuous improvement.

- Partner with People Ops colleagues to identify and implement process improvements that drive efficiency and a better employee experience.

- Maintain data accuracy in Workday and use people analytics to identify trends, surface insights, and support data-driven decision-making.

- Prepare clear, concise people reports and dashboards for stakeholders.

Change Agent

- Support and drive change initiatives by partnering with business leaders on adoption, communication, and sustained behavior change.

- Monitor the effectiveness of change efforts; proactively surface barriers to success and recommend solutions.

- Apply systems thinking to reimagine more efficient ways of getting things done across the People function.

Culture Champion

- Champion programs and practices that foster an inclusive, high-performance culture and improve employee engagement and retention across the employee lifecycle.

- Advocate on behalf of employees and bring forward insights on employee sentiment to inform leadership decisions.

- Model and uphold Showpad’s values in every interaction — acting as a cultural beacon and leading by example.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2 years in an HRBP role.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

- Strong business acumen and the ability to connect people strategies to organizational outcomes.

- Proven ability to manage and resolve complex employee relations matters with empathy, fairness, and legal grounding.

- Solid knowledge of employment laws and HR best practices in the US and EMEA

- Experience executing People programs (merit cycles, performance management, engagement surveys, etc.) with high attention to detail.

- Proficiency with HRIS platforms (Workday a plus) and data reporting tools (Excel, Culture Amp, or similar).

- Strong communicator with the ability to influence and build trust across all levels of the organization.

- Experience in a high-growth, international software or technology company is a strong plus.

ABOUT SHOWPAD

At Showpad, we’re focused on powering the next generation of field selling success through accelerated innovation, expanded global reach, and a holistic engine for lasting growth. We bring content management, sales readiness, buyer engagement, and intelligence into a single, AI-native revenue effectiveness platform that meets sellers where they are — in the field, in the meeting, in the crucial moments. By connecting the human side of field selling with the intelligence of AI, our platform unites field sellers, managers, marketers, partners and enablement teams with a single source of truth, driving consistent execution with your customers and measurable revenue outcomes for your company.

With global offices across the US, EMEA and APAC, Showpad is powered by a diverse global workforce of more than 550 people. Our employee value proposition centers around impact, purpose, and belonging. Our culture is built on flexibility, trust, and setting people up for success. At Showpad, we foster inclusion, innovate for impact, and never stop raising the bar.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM SHOWPAD

We welcome every voice and are committed to building a truly inclusive environment where your differences are not just welcomed, they are celebrated. Whether that’s paid parental leave, paid holidays (including Juneteenth and paid time off to vote), paid time off to volunteer at non-profit organizations, personal development opportunities, or professional stretch assignments — you can expect Showpad to support you.

Showpad’s Commitment

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive organization and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other dimensions of identity. This organization participates in e-verify.
